mapper.sql: SITE_ID=#{scope.siteId} AND ACTOR_ID=#{scope.actorId} AND OPERATION=#{scope.operation} AND SCOPE_KIND=#{scope.scopeKind} AND SCOPE_ID=#{scope.scopeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND REQUEST_KEY=#{scope.requestKey}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dbo.TPS_DOC_TEMPLATE WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE SITE_ID=#{siteId} AND TEMPLATE_ID=#{templateId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ENABLED=1
SELECT * FROM dbo.TPS_DOC_TEMPLATE WHERE SITE_ID=#{siteId} AND TEMPLATE_ID=#{templateId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ENABLED=1
SELECT * FROM dbo.TPS_DOC_REVISION WHERE SITE_ID=#{siteId} AND TEMPLATE_ID=#{templateId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND REVISION_ID=#{revisionId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT t.TEMPLATE_ID,t.NAME,t.OWNER_MODULE,t.HEAD_REVISION_ID,t.HEAD_TOKEN,t.ACTIVE_REVISION_ID,t.CREATED_AT,r.REVISION_NO,r.CREATED_AT AS LAST_SAVED_AT FROM dbo.TPS_DOC_TEMPLATE t JOIN dbo.TPS_DOC_REVISION r ON r.SITE_ID=t.SITE_ID AND r.TEMPLATE_ID=t.TEMPLATE_ID AND r.REVISION_ID=t.HEAD_REVISION_ID WHERE t.SITE_ID=#{siteId} AND t.OWNER_MODULE=#{module} AND t.ENABLED=1 ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC,t.TEMPLATE_ID OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.TPS_DOC_TEMPLATE WHERE SITE_ID=#{siteId} AND OWNER_MODULE=#{module} AND ENABLED=1 AND HEAD_REVISION_ID IS NOT NULL

SELECT TOP (100) SITE_ID,TEMPLATE_ID,REVISION_ID,REVISION_NO,BODY_HASH,CREATED_AT,CREATED_BY FROM dbo.TPS_DOC_REVISION WHERE SITE_ID=#{siteId} AND TEMPLATE_ID=#{templateId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY REVISION_NO DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE dbo.TPS_DOC_TEMPLATE SET HEAD_REVISION_ID=#{revisionId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},NAME=#{name},HEAD_TOKEN=#{newToken} WHERE SITE_ID=#{siteId} AND TEMPLATE_ID=#{templateId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND HEAD_TOKEN=#{oldToken} AND ENABLED=1
